BRANCH TREE | children start at one saved endpoint
parent saved view
  `-- finalCheckpointId = P
       |-- fork(name) -> child A; opens A
       |    `-- forkCheckpointId = P
       |         parent's unsaved edits stay in its working copy
       `-- alternatives(names) -> sibling group
            |-- child B starts at P; canvas stays put
            |-- child C starts at P; saves diverge independently
            `-- alternativeGroupId ties siblings
                 keep(B) saves B; archives siblings and descendants
                 discard(B) archives B and descendants
save active -> append head to checkpointIds; move final
open child -> working copy or final checkpoint
              stash outgoing state; retain current viewport
recording: start -> captured steps -> stop saves
           cancel drops recording metadata, keeps edits
apply -> restore saved final as a fresh checkpoint
